name: Maibara Yukina
source:
Likes: Cooking and eating dumplings, miscellaneous trivia
Dislikes: Sleazy men, umeboshi (doesn't really like sour food)

The class president of [url=/c48319]Kazuya's[/url] class who is also a member of the Intergender Relations Normalization Committee. Though she acts like a leader, takes everything seriously and has a tendency to aim for perfection, she is completely neutral to whether guys and girls get along or not. In reality, Yukina only became the class president and a member of the committee to avoid trouble with a girl who was jealous of her. Her family runs a coffee shop, and Yukina works part-time there as well. She is also best friends with [url=/c41387]Moegi[/url].
